authenticity_review: The image exhibits significant structural hallucinations characteristic of AI generation. Most notably, the large string instruments (resembling cellos) are depicted standing upright on thin, black, leg-like appendages that emerge directly from their bodies, mimicking furniture legs rather than functional instrument stands or endpins. This is a physical impossibility for real instruments. Additionally, the sheep on the right appears to be fused into the body of the second instrument from the right, with indistinct boundaries between wool and wood. The chairs also show slight morphological inconsistencies, with backs blending into the instrument necks behind them. While the lighting and textures are rendered with high fidelity, these structural anomalies severely compromise authenticity.
